metadata.description: Knowledge base rules for the DSS. These rules act as hard filters applied BEFORE AHP/TOPSIS evaluation. Drones that fail any hard constraint are eliminated from consideration.

rule_types.hard_constraint: Drone is eliminated if it fails this rule — non-negotiable
rule_types.soft_constraint: Drone is penalized in scoring but not eliminated
rule_types.regulatory_rule: Derived from EU drone regulations (EU 2019/947, EU 2019/945)

regulatory_rules.name: EU Open Category A1 Limit
regulatory_rules.description: Drones in Open-A1 must weigh under 250g. Not suitable for payload or sensor missions.
regulatory_rules.condition: if regulatory_compliance == 'Open-A1' then max_payload_capacity_kg == 0 AND max_takeoff_weight_kg < 0.25

regulatory_rules.name: EU Open Category A2 Minimum Distance
regulatory_rules.description: Open-A2 drones must maintain 30m horizontal distance from uninvolved persons. Not suitable for crowded port areas.

regulatory_rules.name: Specific Category Authorisation Required
regulatory_rules.description: Drones in Specific category require operational authorisation from national aviation authority before deployment.
regulatory_rules.flag_message: Drone requires EASA Specific category operational authorisation — confirm before procurement.

regulatory_rules.name: Night Operations Requirement
regulatory_rules.description: Night operations require anti-collision lighting and night vision capability per EU regulations.

regulatory_rules.name: Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS)
regulatory_rules.description: Flights beyond visual line of sight require Specific or Certified category compliance.
regulatory_rules.flag_message: Drone range capability restricted to VLOS limits under Open category. BVLOS requires Specific authorisation.

operational_rules.name: Minimum Flight Time
operational_rules.description: Drone must meet minimum flight time for the selected port scenario.

operational_rules.name: Minimum Flight Range
operational_rules.description: Drone must cover the minimum operational range required by the scenario.

operational_rules.name: Weather Resistance for Coastal Environment
operational_rules.description: All drones operating in coastal/salt spray environments must have minimum IP43 rating. IP55 required for fully exposed open-sea ports.

operational_rules.name: Real-Time Transmission for Security Missions
operational_rules.description: Security and emergency scenarios require real-time data transmission to port control.

operational_rules.name: Night Vision for 24/7 Operations
operational_rules.description: 24/7 operational scenarios require at least basic night vision capability.

operational_rules.name: Budget — Initial Cost
operational_rules.description: Drone initial cost must not exceed scenario budget ceiling.

operational_rules.name: Budget — Operational Cost
operational_rules.description: Drone operational cost per hour must not exceed scenario ceiling.

operational_rules.name: Minimum Camera Quality for Inspection
operational_rules.description: Infrastructure inspection missions require minimum camera resolution.

operational_rules.name: Minimum Payload for Sensor Missions
operational_rules.description: Sensor-attachment missions require minimum payload capacity.

operational_rules.name: Minimum Sensor Compatibility for Environmental Missions
operational_rules.description: Environmental monitoring missions require sufficient third-party sensor support.

soft_rules.name: Obstacle Avoidance in Congested Areas
soft_rules.description: Drones without obstacle avoidance are penalized in congested port environments.

soft_rules.name: Non-Swappable Battery for Continuous Ops
soft_rules.description: Drones without swappable batteries are less suitable for continuous/24-7 operations.

soft_rules.name: High Training Requirement
soft_rules.description: Drones requiring more than 7 days of training are flagged as operationally burdensome for small ports.
soft_rules.flag_message: High training requirement — consider staff availability and training budget.

soft_rules.name: High Maintenance Score
soft_rules.description: Drones with maintenance score >= 4 are flagged for small ports with limited technical staff.
soft_rules.flag_message: High maintenance complexity — ensure qualified technical staff are available.

expert_recommendations.name: Tethered Drone for Stationary Surveillance
expert_recommendations.description: Tethered drones (e.g. Hovermast) offer unlimited flight time but near-zero range. Recommended only for fixed-point monitoring, not area coverage.
expert_recommendations.note: Tethered drones should be scored separately or used as a complement to free-flying drones.

expert_recommendations.name: Fixed-Wing for Large Area Coverage
expert_recommendations.description: Fixed-wing UAVs offer superior range and endurance but require more space for operation and lack hovering capability. Best for wide-area environmental and surveillance missions.
expert_recommendations.note: Fixed-wing drones are unsuitable for close-inspection or confined port areas.

expert_recommendations.name: Automated Dock for 24/7 Operations
expert_recommendations.description: Drones with automated launch/recovery pads (e.g. Percepto Sparrow, Zipline) enable fully autonomous continuous operations without human intervention.
expert_recommendations.note: Automated dock systems add infrastructure cost not reflected in drone unit price.
